items.title: The Gentlemen Ransomware Hackers Disable EDR and Backups Before Encrypting Networks in Under 24 Hours
items.description: The Gentlemen ransomware operation is moving from access to full network encryption at striking speed. items.title: WordPress Plugin Flaw Exposes 5 Million Sites to SQL Injection Attacks
items.description: A high-severity vulnerability in the All-in-One WP Migration and Backup plugin could allow unauthenticated attackers to take over vulnerable WordPress sites. items.title: Malicious Apache Modules Turn Trusted Government Websites Into Stealth Phishing Proxies
items.description: Brazilian government websites have been quietly turned into gateways for phishing pages on trusted public domains.
